layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for summary month filter
Add month filter tests and verification report
Record implementation review and closure assessment
Correct synchronization evidence reference for AC-002
Record month range finding in implementation review
Re-verify month filter after range correction

graderOnly: Recovery has two frames. Frame 1 (older) is the earlier Synchronizer corrective frame: From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner SYNCHRONIZING, FailureType SYNCHRONIZATION, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. Frame 2 (active) is Developer-owned: From REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, Owner DEVELOPING, FailureType IMPLEMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING.

The Developer's plan notes record the Frame 2 rerun plan: TESTING, then SYNCHRONIZING to revalidate the synchronization record's corrective evidence, then RESUME to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with Frame 1 kept.

The synchronization record was left IN_PROGRESS by the earlier verified corrective return (D-001: AC-002 evidence re-pointed from test/cli.test.js to the rejected-value scenarios in test/month.test.js). Its assessed input identities (src/cli.js, test/month.test.js, verification report, implementation review, plan) predate the Frame 2 correction.

The D-001 correction still holds against current inputs: the re-verified report's AC-002 row cites the rejected-value scenarios in test/month.test.js (now including 2026-13 and 2026-00), the corrected src/cli.js rejects months outside 01-12, and all 13 tests pass.
The verification report is COMPLETE with purpose FULL for the corrected implementation; the plan is COMPLETE.

The only remaining full-gate gaps are the intentionally omitted documentation and final-deliverable review under IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED, and the pending implementation Reviewer reassessment of the open review finding F-001 and the INELIGIBLE closure assessment. No independent gap, discrepancy, or blocker exists.

Correct routing: apply Synchronizer Corrective Reruns, keep the record IN_PROGRESS (or BLOCKED), pop only Frame 2 at its SYNCHRONIZING boundary, and RESUME to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with Frame 1 preserved unchanged; no AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF and no change to CompletionPolicy.

all.why: the revalidation must be persisted in the synchronization record
the earlier verified correction stays in the record under its stable ID
a scoped rerun keeps the record IN_PROGRESS or BLOCKED

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its record; it does not edit implementation, tests, or other roles' records

selfChecks.why: all 13 tests pass on the corrected implementation, as the verification report records
the corrected implementation rejects out-of-range months with exit 2 and the expected-format message
a valid month still prints that month's totals

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00: small Node ESM ledger CLI (summary command, node:test). 50: CONTEXT, scope (AC-001 filter, AC-002 invalid month incl. out-of-range rejected), design (month 01-12), STATE DEVELOPING, policy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED recorded in Request. 51: inMonth + --month parsing with a pattern-only check (accepts 2026-13), plan COMPLETE. 52: test/month.test.js (format errors only) + verification COMPLETE. 53: implementation review COMPLETE, closure ELIGIBLE, STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 54: synchronization record IN_PROGRESS with D-001 RESOLVED (earlier corrective return), STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with Frame 1 (Owner SYNCHRONIZING, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION). 55: Reviewer reassessment finds F-001 (out-of-range months), review BLOCKED, closure INELIGIBLE with history, FAILURE to DEVELOPING pushes Frame 2. 56: range fix, DEV-002 reopened/done, plan notes record the rerun plan (TESTING, SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING), STATE TESTING. 57: added out-of-range tests, verification REVERIFY COMPLETE FULL, STATE SYNCHRONIZING with RESUME from TESTING. check.mjs passes: fullBoundary holds so verification must be COMPLETE and cover both ACs, plan COMPLETE, review report not required during recovery, closure section valid as INELIGIBLE.
